classification: EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOL (split ATTACK/DEFEND defender training). Not PAPER-FAITHFUL.
authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-26/27: after the repair pair passes the full verifier, freeze the ATTACK/DEFEND split spec -- frozen repaired pi_A on ATTACK, pi_D warm-started from the repaired pi_A, 200k steps, the same N' teacher schedule, CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k=1) -- keeping 2v2 on the 4v4/6v6 role-allocated architecture.
STAGE: canonical lineage step 3 of: 1M base specialist -> entity-repair continuation -> split pi_D (200k, N' teacher) -> Separated crossover -> CD dataset -> distilled suite arms. This spec authorizes step 3 ONLY.

RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_split.policy: A (pi_D is trained from pi_A, as at 4v4 and 6v6)
RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_split.frozen_attack_policy: the repaired pi_A final, pinned by sha256 (--split-attack-defend-frozen-ckpt + --split-attack-defend-frozen-ckpt-sha256); ATTACK slots act with it, no gradient
RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_split.defender_warm_start: --load-path = the SAME repaired pi_A final (weight init only, fresh 200k counter)

n_prime_teacher.loss: CE(macro,GO_TO)+CE(waypoint,w_N') on DEFEND-role, alive, decision-eligible agent-ticks

RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_split.differences_from_4v4: N=2 and k=1 (canonical recipe ALLOWED_TO_DIFFER: 2v2 k=1, 4v4 k=2, 6v6 k=1); seeds and paths. The 4v4 run left --role-k-defend unset (k = N/2 = 2); here k=1 is passed explicitly, as at 6v6 -- at N=2 the default N/2 is also 1, so the resolved value is the same either way.
RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_split.teacher_flags_explicit: 4v4 passed only --defend-teacher-lambda 0.1 and took lambda_end/decay/cadence from defaults; 6v6 and this spec pass all five explicitly. The resolved values are identical to the 4v4 run's (0.1, 0.0, 50000, 150000, 4).
